content_md:
One mistaken conception of the [Thicket](https://blygger.org/thicket/) that I’m now accommodating for is how much it can include oceanic as much as landmassive metaphors.

Feel like I’ve anchored too much on salt-seeking sea navigation and seeing the image now as too idealistically laminar for the medium. It’s more akin to ooblecky molasses: high concentration and viscosity.

Cross-referencing the thickened liquid with jungle brush or tall grasslands when first imagining a thicket helped clarify this. And yet I think the underlying fluid dynamics still hold, the same way it shows up in crowd control or bird migrations, but instead it’s how sound carries through dense physical mediums. Compression and rarefaction?
